items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.annotation: Increases damage taken from our gun, turrets, merc mag, toxic bullets and inflicts much needed Anti-Heal. Shred also works for teammates. Incredibly slot efficient item.

1342610602.annotation: Buy first in lane sometimes over Monster Rounds for more direct HERO damage so less damage to troopers and guardian overall, but more Hero poke/kill power/melee resist for wall + burger boxing.

2951612397.annotation: Extremely efficient duration for its cost on the turrets. Allows you to have a significant amount of turrets at one time. Remember to spread' em if enemy has AoE but also your Heal AoE is GIGANTIC.

1047818222.annotation: You are buying this for unstoppable anyway, but if you buy it earlier, know that you can do things like once lash slams you with ult, you can spawn wall since u have debuff resist b4 he slams and wall

3357231760.annotation: Buy when enemies keep stunning you out of your ult. ALWAYS use unstoppable before ulting. Sometimes use METAL SKIN before ulting too. Pairs well w/ sup duration.

677738769.annotation: Buy when you have placed all your turrets/heal and YOU are about to end the game. Place another batch of turrets and another ultimate. Good for base defense or sieges after using up all cooldowns

1932939246.annotation: OUR WAVE/LANE/TROOPER CLEAR IS SOOOO BAD that this item is OKAY for big waves but it works for ur team. And we can use it before ulting for our teammates + high burn damage.

1378931225.annotation: Buy this against Heroes like Vyper or Haze ult. With Transcendent Cooldown, Metal Skin is 14 cd which is very low. Superior Duration increases makes this go from 5s to 6.4s (HUGE DIFF).

2956256701.annotation: If you have Healing Tempo you can give your allies AND TURRETS the TEMPO buff without using Healing Specter.

915014646.annotation: Superior Cooldown does the job just fine. The only time you consider TransCD is when you need item cooldowns.

381961617.annotation: Reload with lifesteal. Buy this sometimes along with Intensifying Mag to play gun in lane to have more lane presence (and objective damage).

3403085434.annotation: 1) Hit 4800, 2) Move around the map really fast + no speed loss for box/statue maxxing. 3) Remember to activate Fleetfoot before using ULT (you can't use it during ult cuz bad QoL).

876563814.annotation: If you think that you need spirit lifesteal during ult to leech more because you are tanking hits from enemies, buy this.

2163598980.annotation: We usually don't need this item unless the enemy team has 5 or more spirit Heroes.

3270001687.annotation: Warp stone is very good for scaling buildings or getting out of bad situations. Can go further depending on ability range items as well.

951866250.annotation: This will basically make you immortal during your ult vs stuns (if no unstop). It is hard to justify buying both this and Unstop. If Lash ults ults/Haze sleeps or Abrams ult, it activates before stun.

3361811174.annotation: Buy when you need to cast all your spells before dying. Cheat death duration can also be increased with duration items to ensure you cast ALL your spells before dying (or escape!).

1250307611.annotation: Good if you have too much money and no slots.

2462046703.annotation: Buy after shoving the wave (dont always buy 1st think ok). Basically USE/HATCH AFter min 10:01 for MAXIMUM value (buffs upgrade at 10:00). Generally you pop this around ~10-20 for your next 6400 item.

3144988365.annotation: Sometimes the game is about to end whether you win / lose or a critical fight and you just so happen to have 3200 + need anti heal. Decay someone. The range is NUTS w/ Greater exp.

343572757.annotation: Buy when you need severe anti-heal and they have no sign of debuff remover. You can't reliaby target whoever you want with spirit burn unless you ult.

2417568017.annotation: Pretty strong item these past few patches. Use on ally or yourself. Inside heal ur basically taking zero from spirit

1152158042.annotation: Vortex enemies, press unstoppable if you grabbed a few, ult them.

3884003354.annotation: Increases damage taken from our gun, turrets, merc mag, toxic bullets and inflicts much needed Anti-Heal. Shred also works for teammates. Incredibly slot efficient item.

4075861416.annotation: Use this to build up amp for your turrets during longer team fights to make your turrets do actual damage

3731635960.annotation: Sometimes necessary to buy against SILENCE, multiple DISARMS or more importantly SPIRIT BURNS which prevent us from healing. We can handle one anti-heal but two or more or spirit burn is bad for us.

811521119.annotation: Optimal for early wallbreaking anti-tank power. Later becomes a DEBUFF machine against enemies with BRS & Healbane (Urn fighter). Faster jungle too.

1548066885.annotation: More ammo to shoot more from laning phase to mid-game. Sell when you need to buy a bigger item and have no flex slot.

2356412290.annotation: Lets you shoot endlessly without needing to reload.

2971868509.annotation: Spirit damage required to proc bullet shredder. Pair with Tesla or an active item (that deals any spirit damage) if you don't have Tesla. Walkers or enemy everything become much easier to kill w this.

112198670.annotation: Heroes like Seven, Pocket, GTalon, Viscous, Holliday, Kelvin (unless gun), Yamato,Mirage, Geist, Lash, Mina, Sinc, Shiv etc...

84321454.annotation: Infinite / Quick reload for more ammo. This builds into Mercurial Magnum later and it becomes a significant part of our DPS so enjoy the insta-reload.

3919289022.annotation: Infinte AMMO. This item scales with boons/levels. The higher your boons, the more damage you get from it. You don't need other spirit items this item does ULTRA dmg even without spirit items

2407781327.annotation: When you need resists ASAP. This version of Deadlock is incredibly unforgiving to Gun McG so we buy this and if they go on us, they have to waste a lot of resources (use it when heal is on cd or both)

2221211450.annotation: The best item DPS wise in the game (Hard to use, but if you learn how its the best DPS item in the game). Items work for +1 stack too. "Combat" is when u take dmg or when atking. Neutrals work too

989206714.annotation: Extremely good item to prevent getting stunned or CCd by long duration stuns like Abrams charge. Item is also used to move around faster.

1055679805.annotation: The most crucial 6000 item of the build. Provides massive lifesteal to turn the tables on the enemy and gigaburst them with your gun or gives you extra ammo when trying manfight

865846625.annotation: Turrets + Merc Mag give a lot of lifesteal/spiritsteal. It feels pretty decent while becoming super tanky.

710436191.annotation: Not bought often since you need to aim and hit a target, but if you want them to not escape like Lash, Wraith, Mina or something this is an option.

2480592370.annotation: Buy if you can combo w/ team (Lash/Dynamo ult). Firerate is also a huge plus. Pair with Silencer always.

1113837674.annotation: Buy when you have Ricochet and need more crowd control in silence and a passive -25% spirit damage debuff. Very useful utility buy if you have Ricochet. YOU SHOULD BUY THIS IF YOU HAVE RICOCHET ALWAYS

393974127.annotation: VERY GOOD WITH MOVEPSEED ITEMS TO CHASE DOWN ENEMIES

2481177645.annotation: CHOOSE HOLLOW POINT OR THIS. Play sidelanes to get the most out of this item. Provides bullet resist shred up to 20% (if only 1 enemy Hero) or 10% (2+ enemy Hero). Paired with BRS and Suppressor.

4204808176.annotation: The 30% bonus damage applies to ALL of our damage to EVERYTHING for 6 SECONDS including GUN so even mid-game if you parry you gain 30% AMP ON YOUR GUN TO DELETE ANYONE BLOOD TRIUBTE PARRY ABRAMS DEAD

1235347618.annotation: if enemy has bullet damage in order of priority: Haze, Vyper, Wraith (in lane mostly gun), Warden, Drifter, Billy, Ivy and uncommon spirit hero doing gun

3696726732.annotation: Often needed due to lack of anti heal on team. Pairs well with Healbane for -55% enemy heal reduction for cheap.

2037039379.annotation: Extremely good item for healing reduction and reducing enemy spirit + gun damage. Requires buildup but works like Toxic Bullets after buildup and can reset duration forever.

4104549924.annotation: Buy this or Burst Fire. Cost effective fire rate for 800/1600 is a steal. It also beats Burst Fire for objectives since it requires Hero damage to proc as opposed to Swift Striker needing nothing.

2739107182.annotation: You can skip Burst Fire for Blood Tribute if you know how to use Blood Tribute.

2463960640.annotation: You can skip Titanic Mag and buy this a little later if you predict that you need some bullet resist while also investing into a gun item.

339443430.annotation: Debuffs wear off way faster. More of a tanky item and we move really fast too. Pairs amazingly with COlossus

365620721.annotation: Will +1.5x our DPS late game (~550) with 0 stacks, 26 headshots, 100 body, 30 boons. LUCKY SHOT does a bit less DPS (470 to 520 RNG) unless u value HEALTH over DPS. Need ~200% wpn for Lucky to outdps

673001892.annotation: Buy against BULLET EVASION (main use), PLATED ARMOR or HIGH BULLET RES. ***This item will help you lifesteal way more with Vampiric vs high bullet resist***

1396247347.annotation: Buy only when you have high amounts of weapon damage 200+ (Remember to count Berserker stacks manually). This item will give you insane extra bonus damage additively. Glass is better than Lucky 4 DPS

1409190604.annotation: You can buy this alongside Vampiric Burst just to have that extra firerate and spirit resist if you don't mind having another active button to press. Amazing firerate w/ Blood Tribute too.

3491236900.annotation: Tank up even more ontop of the bullet resist that we have. Even if enemies buy armor piercing rounds it doesn't completely negate the usefulness of this item at all.

1955841979.annotation: Buy when you need 1) Spirit Resist & 2) Debuff Resist and spirit resist & 3) Have a lot of money to spend. Debuff Resist is for annoying things like Curse..

2947183272.annotation: why they nerf lifesteal... anyway spam this for heals and Healing Tempo procs

1439347412.annotation: Moar sustain but also purple invested

1710079648.annotation: If your lane partner is aggro/easily harrassed, get this instead of Extra / Mystic Regen (for now)

2061878743.annotation: Vs heroes with gun kits (Haze, Silver, Grey Talon, etc.)
